name: java
description: trailbeam-aws-sdk-v2 (Java): the global ExecutionInterceptor on the AWS SDK for Java v2 sync client, with no code, on a plain classpath and inside a Spring Boot executable jar. Build first: mvn -f java/pom.xml install && mvn -f conformance/drivers/java/pom.xml package. The agent variants need OTEL_JAVA_AGENT_JAR (2.34.0) and DD_JAVA_AGENT_JAR (1.69.1).

variants.name: alone
variants.about: only Trailbeam: the jar on the classpath, no agent, no code

variants.name: otel-agent
variants.about: beside the OpenTelemetry Java agent: every span is a child of the agent's exported span, except receives, which are roots (the agent makes no span for a ReceiveMessage without an active span, as in a poll loop; contract section 2, Java note)

variants.name: otel-agent-sampled-0
variants.about: as otel-agent, with the agent's sampler at 0%: Trailbeam's always-on provider must still export every span, each still a child of the agent's (unexported) span

variants.name: dd-agent
variants.about: beside dd-java-agent (no Datadog agent running: its spans go nowhere, Trailbeam's still reach the Collector)

variants.name: spring-boot
variants.about: the same driver as a Spring Boot executable jar (java -jar), the SDK and Trailbeam nested under BOOT-INF/lib: the SDK must find the jar's execution.interceptors through Spring Boot's class loader

variants.name: spring-boot-otel-agent
variants.about: the Spring Boot jar beside the OpenTelemetry Java agent, with otel-agent's parent check
